name: Shizuoka

flag.description: An orange emblem edged in white on a blue field: the outline of the prefecture shaped into Mount Fuji.
flag.symbolism: The emblem simplifies Mount Fuji, the Izu Peninsula, Suruga Bay and Cape Omaezaki into one shape; blue is the sky and the Pacific, orange the sunshine and the people's passion.

hook: Shizuoka's orange emblem on blue is its own coastline bent into the shape of Mount Fuji.
trivia: Shizuoka is one of Japan's biggest green tea growers.
Tokugawa Ieyasu spent his retirement at Sunpu Castle, in today's Shizuoka City.
